verdict.rationale: RudderStack is warehouse-native, so collected event data stays portable. It loads events into your own warehouse or data lake on a predefined schema and stores data "on your own infrastructure, not ours." Profiles are declared in version-controlled YAML that generates warehouse-native SQL, and an open-source self-hosted version runs on PostgreSQL. There is no documented export tool, though, and no explicit open-format guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit data/config export feature, named open export formats (e.g., Parquet/CSV/JSON), a documented way to export workspace configuration (sources, destinations, transformations), and independent hands-on evidence of migrating off RudderStack.
